content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To fry dandelions, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Gather a basket for foraging (2 minutes)
Step 2. Set the table for dining (5 minutes)
Step 3. Serve the hot fried dandelions (2 minutes)
Step 4. Heat oil in a heavy skillet (8 minutes)
Step 5. Pat the rinsed flowers completely dry with paper towels (10 minutes)
Step 6. Locate a patch of unsprayed dandelions in the yard (5 minutes)
Step 7. Dip the flower heads into the prepared batter (15 minutes)
Step 8. Harvest the freshest dandelion blossoms (20 minutes)
Step 9. Measure out the all-purpose flour (1 minute)
Step 10. Pluck the green sepals from the base of the flowers (30 minutes)
Step 11. Add a pinch of salt to the dry mix (30 seconds)
Step 12. Whisk the flour and spices together (2 minutes)
Step 13. Crack the eggs into a small bowl (1 minute)
Step 14. Check the oil temperature with a thermometer (3 minutes)
Step 15. Sift the cornmeal to remove lumps (2 minutes)
Step 16. Pour the frying oil into the pan (1 minute)
Step 17. Retrieve the vegetable oil from the pantry (2 minutes)
Step 18. Dust the dried flowers with a light coating of flour (5 minutes)
Step 19. Clean up the batter station (10 minutes)
Step 20. Place fried flowers on a wire rack to drain (4 minutes)
Step 21. Rinse the dandelion heads in cold water (5 minutes)
Step 22. Spin the flowers in a salad spinner (2 minutes)
Step 23. Find the mixing bowls in the cupboard (3 minutes)
Step 24. Sort through the harvest to remove any insects (10 minutes)
Step 25. Prepare a side of dipping sauce (6 minutes)
Step 26. Get the serving plates ready (2 minutes)
Step 27. Combine the wet and dry ingredients (3 minutes)
Step 28. Walk out to the garden (4 minutes)
Step 29. Shake off excess dirt from the stems (3 minutes)
Step 30. Soak the blossoms in salt water to remove bitterness (30 minutes)
Step 31. Dredge the battered flowers in breadcrumbs (12 minutes)
Step 32. Fold the napkins (2 minutes)
Step 33. Set out the appetizer forks (1 minute)
Step 34. Beat the eggs until frothy (2 minutes)
Step 35. Compost the discarded green stems (1 minute)
Step 36. Wipe down the kitchen counter (5 minutes)
Step 37. Peel a clove of garlic for the sauce (2 minutes)
Step 38. Pour a glass of sparkling water (1 minute)
Step 39. Lay out a cooling tray (2 minutes)
Step 40. Clear the stove area (5 minutes)
Step 41. Dredge the flowers in a final layer of cornmeal (8 minutes)
Step 42. Measure the smoked paprika (1 minute)
Step 43. Whisk the eggs with a splash of milk (1 minute)
Step 44. Organize the breading station (4 minutes)
Step 45. Fry the dandelions in small batches until golden (15 minutes)
Step 46. Carefully place flowers into the hot oil (6 minutes)
Step 47. Trim the long stems off (10 minutes)
Step 48. Spread the flowers on a towel to air out (15 minutes)
Step 49. Season the hot flowers with a dusting of sea salt (1 minute)
Step 50. Add black pepper to the flour mixture (30 seconds)
